body:
The distinct antigorite lead is Liu et al. (2022), *Actinobacteria-mediated serpentine dissolution and implication for biosignatures on Mars*, Chemical Geology 590:120697, DOI https://doi.org/10.1016/j.chemgeo.2021.120697. Round 69 verified publisher, Crossref and OpenAlex metadata, but did not acquire the complete primary article or relevant supplement. No antigorite record or CREATE history was admitted from excerpts.

The public Elsevier response contains only core metadata, despite its full-text wrapper. OpenAlex reports closed access with no repository full text. Bounded title/DOI/author/institution searches and a conventional supplement route did not supply the required original. These are acquisition limits, not evidence that the methods or supplements do not exist. A request-copy landing page was located; no author contact was made.

Acceptance criteria:

1. Acquire a legitimate complete original or accepted manuscript and relevant original figures, tables and supplements. Retain URL, version, access date and checksums; distinguish a metadata response from full scientific content. Avoid repeating unchanged denied endpoints.
2. Verify antigorite identity and feed composition, pretreatment, Streptomyces FXJ8.102 provenance, biomass state, medium, temperature, pH, duration, loading, replication and abiotic controls.
3. Inspect surface microscopy, elemental ratios and secondary glushinskite phase evidence. Separate local surface change, bulk dissolved release, proposed mechanical/chemical causes and isolated recovery. Do not import abstract dimensions, yields or causal language without the original basis.
4. Repeat hidden/ignored-inclusive deduplication across records, research, reviews, history and referenced downloads. Existing dunite feed descriptions containing antigorite do not establish a phase-specific mechanism.
5. Curate only supported claims with canonical history, independent exact-byte review and required gates, or save a reasoned source deferral. Completion of the round 69 calcium-oxalate pair does not resolve this acquisition gap.

Handoff: `research/sources/round69-silicates/20261014T104745Z-source-investigation.md` and paired JSON. Raw metadata/acquisition receipts are retained outside Git in `/private/tmp/cmm-round69-silicates-research`.

Duplicate check: the fresh all-state inventory contained 136 actual issues. Title/body searches for antigorite, 120697 and FXJ8.102 found no duplicate; repository/source searches included hidden and ignored files as documented in the dossier.
title: Acquire the complete antigorite–Streptomyces primary study before mechanism curation
